name: Glaucous-Lament
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by an ancient meteor crater, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Nothing about the radiation hotspot appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Research vessels hold position at a respectful distance and take turns being unnerved. The anomaly, for its part, seems patient.
